### 🎯 Localization Issue
What specific localization problem are you experiencing?

#### Translation Issues
- [ ] **Incorrect Translation** - Translation is wrong or inaccurate
- [ ] **Missing Translation** - Text is not translated
- [ ] **Literal Translation** - Translation is too literal
- [ ] **Cultural Inappropriateness** - Translation is culturally inappropriate
- [ ] **Grammar Errors** - Translation has grammar mistakes
- [ ] **Spelling Errors** - Translation has spelling mistakes
- [ ] **Inconsistent Terminology** - Inconsistent use of terms
- [ ] **Outdated Translation** - Translation is outdated

#### Text Display Issues
- [ ] **Text Truncation** - Text is cut off or truncated
- [ ] **Text Overflow** - Text doesn't fit in allocated space
- [ ] **Font Issues** - Font doesn't support the language
- [ ] **Character Encoding** - Characters display incorrectly
- [ ] **Right-to-Left Issues** - RTL language problems
- [ ] **Text Direction** - Incorrect text direction
- [ ] **Line Breaking** - Improper line breaking
- [ ] **Text Alignment** - Incorrect text alignment

### 📊 Translation Quality Assessment

#### Accuracy
- [ ] **Completely Accurate** - Translation is perfect
- [ ] **Mostly Accurate** - Minor inaccuracies
- [ ] **Partially Accurate** - Significant inaccuracies
- [ ] **Mostly Inaccurate** - Major translation errors
- [ ] **Completely Inaccurate** - Translation is wrong

#### Naturalness
- [ ] **Very Natural** - Sounds like native language
- [ ] **Somewhat Natural** - Mostly natural with minor issues
- [ ] **Somewhat Unnatural** - Noticeable translation issues
- [ ] **Very Unnatural** - Clearly translated
- [ ] **Unreadable** - Translation is unreadable

#### Completeness
- [ ] **Complete** - Everything is translated
- [ ] **Mostly Complete** - Minor missing translations
- [ ] **Partially Complete** - Significant missing translations
- [ ] **Mostly Incomplete** - Major missing translations
- [ ] **Incomplete** - Most text is not translated
